title: Alien Exodus - RTS
description: Top-down real-time strategy game: crash-landed on an alien world, build a base, harvest mana crystals, train units, and destroy the insectoid hive before they overrun you.
prompt:
GAME: Alien Exodus - RTS

GENRE: Real-Time Strategy (RTS) - single screen, base-building, Red Alert inspired

SETTING: A hostile alien planet with purple/pink skies, bioluminescent flora, crystal formations, and alien rock spires. NOT earth-themed — trees are tall purple fungal stalks, rocks are glowing crystal shards, ground is orange/red alien soil.

STORY: A human expedition crash-landed on an alien world. The native alien insectoids attack. Build a base, farm mana crystals (resource), train units, and destroy the alien hive.

CONTROLS:
- Left-click to select your units/buildings
- Right-click to move selected units / attack enemies
- Click on a building to see its production options
- Number keys 1-9 for hotkeys
- ESC to deselect

DIFFICULTY (choose at start screen):
- Easy: AI is slow, starts with less, gives you time
- Medium: Balanced
- Hard: AI expands fast, attacks aggressively

CORE MECHANICS:
- Start with a Command Center (your main base) and 2 resource collectors
- Alien planet has crystal deposits (glowing purple crystals) — harvest them for credits
- Build: Refinery (processes crystals faster), Barracks (trains infantry), Vehicle Depot (builds tanks), Turret (defense), Power Plant (increases build speed)
- Units: Marine (rifle soldier), Sniper (long range), Grenadier (AoE), Scout Jeep (fast), Tank (slow heavy), Mech Walker (medium)
- Enemy (Aliens): Swarmlings (fast melee), Spitter (ranged poison), Ravager (tank), Queen (boss)
- Tech tree: build Power Plant first, then unlock stronger units
- Fog of war — unexplored areas are dark

VISUAL STYLE:
- Top-down 2D RTS view (birds eye)
- Dark purple/orange color palette
- Simple shapes but clear unit icons and health bars
- Minimap in bottom-right corner
- Resource counter + unit count at top
- Buildings have construction animation

WIN/LOSE:
- Win: Destroy all enemy buildings
- Lose: All your buildings are destroyed
- Instant restart button on game over

SINGLE FILE HTML — all vanilla JavaScript, Canvas-based rendering. Must work offline.
